## Download the full section
**[academy-bundle.docx](academy-bundle.docx)** — every Academy module concatenated
into one Word document. Regenerated on every site deploy. Each module is also

The UIAO Academy is the site's **learning front door**, organized the same
way the rest of the site is: by the three operational expressions of the
governance substrate. **OrgPath** governs, **OrgComp** proves federal
organizational compliance, **OrgMod** modernizes — pick the pillar you are
here to learn, or the contributor path if you work on the substrate itself.
The Academy invents no curriculum of its own: every path below sequences
material that is already published and canon-governed, per
[ADR-131](../adr/adr-131-academy-org-family-umbrella.qmd).

![The Org family: three operational expressions — OrgPath (governance), OrgComp (Federal Organizational Compliance), and OrgMod (Organizational Modernization) — standing on one governance substrate of identity, addressing, evidence, and policy-bearing control planes. OrgComp connects to the substrate through a dashed Evidence & Authorization Contract seam, and a footer band states the three are adoptable together or each on its own.](../customer-documents/orgcomp-series/figs/org-family-substrate.png){width="100%"}

## Pick your path

### OrgPath — Governance

Learn the governance expression: canon as the source of truth, addressing
as the governed namespace, drift as the closed loop. The staged
walkthrough — read, do, verify at every stage — is the
**[OrgPath path](orgpath-path.qmd)**; the table below is its skeleton.

| Stage | What you learn | Start here |
|---|---|---|
| **See it work** | The working loop, end to end, in minutes | [AD → Drift → Signed Evidence in 10 minutes](../docs/orgpath-golden-path.qmd) |
| **The architecture** | OrgTree, LocPath, the codebook, delegation, dynamic membership | [Reference Architecture](../customer-documents/reference-architecture/index.qmd) |
| **The reasoning** | The full story, not just the runbook | [OrgPath reading sequence](../customer-documents/orgpath-narrative/index.qmd) — the twenty-nine-book narrative |
| **Run it** | Rolling OrgPath onto Intune and Azure Arc | [OrgPath implementation guides](../customer-documents/operational-guides/orgpath-implementation/index.qmd) |
| **The law** | MACD-R lifecycle, Closure Provenance, the SSOT registry | [One lifecycle, three pillars](../orgpath/index.qmd#macdr) |

Entry point for everything above: the
[OrgPath pillar landing](../orgpath/index.qmd).

### OrgComp — Compliance

The compliance curriculum is **owned by the series it teaches**: the
[OrgComp Training Program](../customer-documents/orgcomp-series/OrgComp-Training-Program/index.qmd)
is the two-track academy over the Federal Organization Compliance book
series, and this page routes you there rather than duplicating it.

| Track | Audience | Start here |
|---|---|---|
| **Track A — Compliance** | ISSOs / ISSMs, assessors, ConMon operators | [Compliance track](../customer-documents/orgcomp-series/OrgComp-Training-Program/compliance-track.qmd) |
| **Track B — Implementation** | Network, platform, database, identity, and security engineers | [Implementation track](../customer-documents/orgcomp-series/OrgComp-Training-Program/implementation-track.qmd) |
| **Vendor catalog** | Anyone mapping books to external vendor training | [Vendor training catalog](../customer-documents/orgcomp-series/OrgComp-Training-Program/vendor-training-catalog.qmd) |

The series itself starts at the
[OrgComp pillar landing](../customer-documents/orgcomp-series/index.qmd),
and its doctrine spine is
[Vol 0 Book 00](../customer-documents/orgcomp-series/Vol_0_Book_00_OrgComp_Executive_Summary.qmd).

### OrgMod — Modernization

Learn the modernization expression: moving a legacy estate forward without
rip-and-replace, governed by the same spine. The staged walkthrough is the
**[OrgMod path](orgmod-path.qmd)**; the table below is its skeleton.

| Stage | What you learn | Start here |
|---|---|---|
| **The bridge** | What replaces AD's implicit infrastructure roles | [Directory Migration — the AD infrastructure bridge](../customer-documents/reference-architecture/directory-migration.qmd) |
| **The journey** | The end-to-end transformation program | [Microsoft Client-Server to Hybrid-Cloud](../customer-documents/operational-guides/client-server-to-hybrid-cloud/index.qmd) |
| **The planes** | Modernizing endpoints and servers | [Intune + Azure Arc Modernization](../customer-documents/operational-guides/intune-arc-modernization/index.qmd) |
| **The identity pipe** | The HR-driven joiner/mover/leaver feed | [HRIT to HR-Driven IAM Execution Plan](../customer-documents/orgcomp-series/OrgComp_HRIT_HR_Driven_IAM_Execution_Plan.qmd) |
| **A worked consumer** | A twenty-year SQL estate off Windows Authentication | [SQL Server Identity Transformation](../customer-documents/sql-server-narrative/index.qmd) |

Entry point for everything above: the
[OrgMod pillar landing](../orgmod/index.qmd), and the full task-oriented
shelf at [Modernization guides](../customer-documents/operational-guides/index.qmd).

### Contributor — working on the substrate itself

For developers, canon stewards, and CI engineers landing changes inside the
substrate. This path carries
[UIAO_125 §1.2](https://github.com/WhalerMike/uiao/blob/main/src/uiao/canon/specs/program-training.md)
forward substantially unchanged.

- [Contributor track](contributor-track.qmd) — stage-by-stage: foundation
  read, canon change protocol, schema authoring, adapter development,
  release engineering.
- [Tier-1 test environment setup](contributor-tier-1-setup.qmd) — one free
  Microsoft 365 Developer Program tenant, one API credential, one
  fixture-ready pipeline.
- [Adapter Integration Guide — Entra ID](adapters/entra-id.qmd) — the
  complete worked adapter integration, from app registration to conformance
  verification.
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/WhalerMike/uiao/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md)
  — the canon change protocol itself.

## Canon anchors

The Academy presents; the canon governs. The anchors:

| Anchor | Role |
|---|---|
| [ADR-131](../adr/adr-131-academy-org-family-umbrella.qmd) | The Academy's charter: umbrella entry point, pillar-first, one front door; pillar curricula owned where they live |
| [UIAO_125 Training Program](https://github.com/WhalerMike/uiao/blob/main/src/uiao/canon/specs/program-training.md) | Track definitions, shared core, and completion criteria — the Contributor path's substance |
| [UIAO_128 Education Program](https://github.com/WhalerMike/uiao/blob/main/src/uiao/canon/specs/program-education.md) | The comic-led learning arc behind the orientation layer |

## Rebuild status

This landing page is the ADR-131 D1 structure, and the
[OrgPath](orgpath-path.qmd) and [OrgMod](orgmod-path.qmd) staged paths are
the D4 Phase 3 content, shipped. The former Operator track's substance now
lives in those two paths; its [page](operator-track.qmd) remains reachable
as a signpost until Phase 4 retires it with a URL alias. The mechanics
guides (document generation, image pipeline) are the remaining Phase 4
work and still carry their banners.
